name: Tameeni Insurance
verdict: Tameeni is a subsidiary of Rasan Information Technology, a Saudi fintech listed on the Saudi Exchange (Tadawul: 8313). Nothing found.
note: Saudi insurance-comparison platform; front of several Saudi Pro League shirts in 2026/27, including Al-Hazem. Owner traced to Rasan Information Technology, a Saudi joint-stock company listed on the Saudi Exchange (listed 2024-06-13); founded by the Alfallaj brothers. No state body or fund found in the chain, and no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company found (searched 2026-10-03).
